title: 第5章 给大小姐治病第6章 唐诗潇
content_zh:
;;
“哎呦……”
唐诗逸痛叫了一声。
“唐小姐，你怎么了？”
“没关系，老毛病了。”
唐诗逸一手捂着肚子，一手扶着挺翘的后身。
陈楚皱着眉头。
“你这是痔疮？”
“啊呀！”
唐诗逸脸红的不得了。
一个女孩子，让人说出这种话，而且还说对了。
“陈楚，你讨厌啊！”
“唉，唐小姐，我也懂得一些医术的，在行医者面前，痔疮就是一种病，而不是什么难以启齿的事情。”
欢喜鏖战大法当中，记载很多医术，也被陈楚传承了。
“唐小姐，而且你这种痔疮很不同啊，像是被下蛊了。”
“什么？下蛊？”
“是的。”陈楚非常的笃定：“唐小姐你是开制药公司的，不可能痔疮这种小事也治不好的。”
唐诗逸想想也对，这痔疮伴随她三年了。
在三年前的一天，偶然回家，身体便难受，三年里，她承受了非常多的苦难。
甚至都不敢去相亲。

如果继续这样下去，终身大事都要耽误了。
她忍着疼。
“陈先生，不瞒你说，我每次治疗也仅仅缓解，不能去根，你能去根的话，做什么我都愿意。”
“好，一言为定。”
陈楚开始在她的中药店翻找起来。
先后找出了蜈蚣、螳螂、黄蜂、屎壳郎、马粪包、冬虫夏草……
十几种干枯的虫子和一些有特殊气味的药材。
然后进行油炸，烘烤，碾碎。
满屋子全是无比的香气撩人。
搞的唐诗逸都忍不住淌出了哈喇子。
忍不住说：“你弄得太香了，要不是我知道是虫子，都想吃一口了。”
“唐小姐，请和我进卧室。”
“奥。”唐诗逸有些脸红，跟着进来。
“唐小姐，脱吧。”

"Ouch..."
Tang Shiyi screamed in pain.
"Miss Tang, what's wrong with you?"
"It's okay, it's the same old problem."
Tang Shiyi covered her stomach with one hand and supported her straight back body with the other.
Chen Chu frowned.
"Do you have hemorrhoids?"
"Ah!"
Tang Shiyi blushed extremely.
A girl, let people say such things, and she said it right.
"Chen Chu, you are annoying!"
"Hey, Miss Tang, I also know some medical skills. In front of medical practitioners, hemorrhoids are just a disease, not something unspeakable."
Many medical skills were recorded in the Dafa of Joyful Fighting, which were also passed down by Chen Chu.
"Ms. Tang, your hemorrhoids are very different, as if they were bewitched."
"What? Poison?"
"Yes." Chen Chu was very sure: "Ms. Tang, you run a pharmaceutical company. It's impossible that you can't cure something as small as hemorrhoids."
Tang Shiyi was right when she thought about it. She had been suffering from hemorrhoids for three years.
One day three years ago, she accidentally returned home and felt unwell. In the past three years, she had endured a lot of suffering.
I don’t even dare to go on a blind date.
If this continues, life-long events will be delayed.
She endured the pain.
"Mr. Chen, to tell you the truth, every time I treat it, it can only provide relief and cannot remove the root. If you can remove the root, I will do whatever you want."
"Okay, it's settled."
Chen Chu started rummaging in her Chinese medicine store.
We found centipedes, praying mantises, wasps, dung beetles, horse dung bags, cordyceps...
More than a dozen kinds of dried insects and some medicinal herbs with special smells.
Then fried, baked, and crushed.
The whole house is filled with an incomparable and alluring fragrance.
Tang Shiyi couldn't help but burst into tears.
I couldn't help but say, "You made it so fragrant. If I hadn't known it was a bug, I would have wanted to take a bite."
"Ms. Tang, please come into the bedroom with me."
"Oh." Tang Shiyi blushed a little and followed in.
"Miss Tang, take off your clothes."
